scripts.ci: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ui-contracts && npm run test:packaging && npm run test:ci-contract && npm run test:core && npm run build
